sections.title: About
sections.body:
I build offensive security tools, OSINT workflows, network analysis tools, and secure local-first applications. My work spans vulnerability scanning, recon automation, cryptography, password security, and CTF challenges. I also contribute to cybersecurity communities through design, branding, event infrastructure, and club-led initiatives.

Aliases: Dreadonyx, BlackPantherX, Tr1ck5ter, h3m4n1h
B.E. CSE (Cyber Security) · Velammal Engineering College
2024–2028 · Fourth semester completed

sections.title: Featured projects
sections.body:
Aegis [Project]
A local SOC and deception lab that ingests Cowrie telemetry, tracks incidents, explains detections, and exports evidence-linked analyst reports.
Python, FastAPI, SQLite, Cowrie, Docker

ThrustGuard [Project]
IoT behavioral trust scoring with policy rules, statistical drift checks, anomaly detection, hash-chained audit logs, and LLM-assisted incident reports.
Python, FastAPI, Isolation Forest, Ollama, SQLite

SpecterNet [Project]
A network analysis tool with live packet capture, HTTP/FTP/Telnet/SMTP inspection, traffic visualization, plaintext credential detection, and threaded port scanning.
Python, PyQt6, Scapy, Threading

SentinelX [Project]
AST-based Python scanning and secret detection, with AI-assisted attack paths, proof-of-concept payloads, and impact summaries for security research.
Python, AST analysis, AI analysis

PhantomEye [Project]
Concurrent OSINT checks across 100+ platforms, with username, email, IP, domain, and phone modules, DNS and security-header checks, and HTML reports.
OSINT, Concurrent checks, HTML reports

SafeKey [Project]
A local-first password manager with AES-256-GCM vault encryption, PBKDF2 key derivation, per-entry IVs, clipboard timeout, inactivity auto-lock, and password strength feedback. Supports browser, desktop, and Android distribution.
Web Crypto API, Tauri, Local-first

CipherX [Project]
Multi-layer cipher and encoding detection with Base64, hex, ROT13, Morse and more. Includes Caesar, XOR and Vigenere workflows, flag scoring, steganography, and hash identification.
Cryptography, CTFs, Encoding

RoadSOS [Project]
National Road Safety Hackathon 2026 project using a TFLite sensor model, OpenStreetMap road checks, a two-step cancel flow, emergency calls and SMS, realtime bystander alerts, and first-aid guidance.
TFLite, Android, Twilio, Supabase

Cyventura CTF Platform [Project]
A weekly CTF platform with authentication, challenges, flag submissions, leaderboards, events, and admin tools. Includes hashed passwords and flags, rate limiting, and upload validation.
FastAPI, MongoDB, React, Vite

CTF-AI [Project]
An AI-assisted CTF learning tool designed to help beginners reason through challenge concepts and build problem-solving confidence.
Python, Gemini, Docker

SpecFit [Project]
A Flask system health dashboard using psutil to track CPU and memory, classify NORMAL, STRAINED, and OVERLOADED states, identify top memory consumers, and explain conditions with Groq.
Flask, psutil, Groq

GHOST [Concept]
A modular local assistant concept built around distinct workflow modes and configurable model support.
Local tooling, CLI

Yugma [Concept]
A platform concept for connecting college clubs and making inter-college coordination easier.
Next.js, Tailwind CSS

AttendQR [Project]
A QR-based attendance project built around a lightweight web application and a SQLite fallback.
Flask, SQLite, QR codes

nmapx [Project]
A web interface for Nmap with WebSocket output streaming, readable scan summaries, scan profiles, and Groq-assisted threat analysis.
Nmap, WebSockets, Groq

CertFlow [Project]
A Flask certificate generator with participant lists, template previews, layout controls, and batch ZIP exports for college and event workflows. Also known as Certs-Automator.
Flask, Batch generation, Templates

ChessForge [Project]
A custom chess platform with move validation, endgame detection, a board editor, themes, and Chess960 with castling support.
Chess960, Board editor, Game rules

GhostC2 [Project]
Python C2 framework for CTFs and authorized penetration testing, with multi-session management, payload generation, listeners, file transfer, system information, and session cleanup.
Python, CTF labs, CLI

ScanForge [Project]
A modular Python web scanner with link and form crawling, checks for SQL injection, XSS, local file inclusion, open redirects and missing security headers, plus JSON and HTML reports.
Python, Web security, Reporting

AI CLI [Project]
A dependency-free Python assistant unifying 10 providers and 100+ models, with interactive chat, piped input, provider and model listings, and model switching mid-chat.
Python, CLI, AI providers

steg-art [Project]
An image pipeline using Groq prompt enhancement and FLUX.1-schnell through Hugging Face, with LSB message embedding in PNGs and encode/decode APIs.
FLUX, Groq, LSB steganography

snipe [Project]
A Telegram bot scanning RSS, DuckDuckGo, and CTFtime every 30 minutes. Uses Groq filtering and SQLite preferences and deduplication for hackathons, internships, CTFs, and other opportunities.
Telegram, Groq, SQLite

UI Album [Project]
A React and Vite component gallery exploring timelines, dashboards, heroes, forms, docks, grids, and other reusable interface patterns.
React, Vite, UI design

3D Portfolio Website [Project]
A React portfolio with a custom 3D keyboard, particles, elastic cursor, and scroll-driven animation, built with Three.js, React Three Fiber, Spline, GSAP, and Framer Motion.
React, Three.js, Spline, GSAP

flappy-bird [Project]
A lightweight HTML and JavaScript Flappy Bird implementation that runs directly in the browser without an install step.
HTML, JavaScript, Game

snake_game [Project]
A Java Snake game with separate rendering, controller, and model layers. Each apple earns 400 points; reaching 4000 points reveals a CTF flag.
Java, Game, CTF

Procedural Font Foundry [Project]
Four original fonts—CypherDiamond, QuantumMono, NovaGrid, and Etherence—generated mathematically in Python, with TTF outputs and a preview and download landing page.
Python, Typography, Vector geometry

sections.title: Help / exit
sections.body:
1–8: open a section
Up/down: choose a section or scroll
Enter: select
Esc / backspace: back to menu
q / Ctrl+C: exit

Read-only portfolio. No OS shell or file transfer.
No analytics or visitor-input logging. Connection addresses are held in memory briefly for abuse prevention.

For plain output: ssh -T -p 2222 visitor@127.0.0.1
The local address is a development example.
